s: waters grants glory (to those who sacrifice piously)
q: to that man ye give both splendour and glory, with health and vigour of the body and prominence of form

s: waters grants a legitimate scion
q: yea, to him ye give possessions which entail abundant glory, and a legitimate scion

s: waters grants best world of the saints (as the final reward)
q: and (Heaven at the last), the best life of the saints, shining, all glorious.

s: Yasna is a sacrifice (religious ceremony)
q: may’st thou be present at our Yasna; may’st thou come to us to help, as we chant our full-offered Yast, with the full offering of Zaothras.

q: as it is the most legitimate Yasna, and homage of them (all) because of Righteousness the Best.

s: Yasna offers Weal (through prayer and praise)
q: And by this may I gain (that) blessing, the good Blessedness (our sanctity rewarded).

s: village has dwellers the dwellers (in this village)

s: village receives safe abode (through benediction)
q: for a safe abode, for a joyful and a long abode for the dwellers in this village

s: Good Mind is a means of salvation (through divine assistance)
q: cause us to prosper to salvation through Thy Good Mind

s: Righteous Order is a straightest path (because of Righteousness)
q: Grant to us both the desire of, and the knowledge of that straightest path, the straightest because of Righteousness

s: Righteous Order is related to Ahura Mazda (as part of his ritual and law)
q: cause us to prosper to salvation through Thy Good Mind, the Sovereign Power, and Thy Righteous Order (in Thy ritual and law)!

s: Kine is a herds of blessed gift
q: Praise to the Kine (the herds of blessed gift).

q: cause us to prosper to salvation through Thy Good Mind, the Sovereign Power, and Thy Righteous Order (in Thy ritual and law)!

s: Fravashi of Zarathustra is related to Zarathustra (his Fravashi)
q: Praise to Gaya (Maretan) and to the Fravashi of Zarathustra (first of) saints

s: best world of the saints is a Heaven (shining and all glorious)
q: and (Heaven at the last), the best life of the saints, shining, all glorious.

s: Ahurian One (Ahura Mazda) is a daughter of Ahura
q: We offer this to thee, O Ahurian (daughter) of Ahura! as a help (?) for life.

s: Ahurian One (Ahura Mazda) receives Zaothra (as an offering for satisfaction)
q: If we have offended thee, let this Zaothra then attain to thee (for satisfaction), for it is thine with its Haoma, and its milk, and its Hadhânaêpata.

s: Ahurian One (Ahura Mazda) is worshipped with good thoughts (through the Zaothras)
q: Yea, we worship thee with sacrifice, O thou Ahurian (daughter) of Ahura with the Zaothras of the good thought

s: Ahurian One (Ahura Mazda) grants Heaven (to the worshipper)
q: And grant me, O thou Ahurian One! Heaven, and to have an offspring manly and legitimate

s: Ahura Mazda is a Great Creator (divine living Lord)
q: and in truth, how he may become like Thee, O Great Creator, Living Lord

s: Ahura Mazda is the same (for every hour)
q: O Ahura Mazda! Thou who art for every hour the same!

s: Righteousness is divine Righteousness
q: And when the Divine Righteousness shall be inclined to my appeal

s: Righteousness is the better lot (given through the Righteous Order)
q: since through (Thy) Righteous Order the better (lot) is given

s: Righteousness is followed by the wise (in words and actions)
q: With Thy Good Mind and Thy (holy) Kingdom he follows the Righteous Order both in his words and his actions.

s: Good Mind is beneficent (supported by Ahura Mazda)
q: And thus likewise He supports His Beneficent Mind (in His saints).

s: Good Mind is within the living believers (as a fatherly divine presence)
q: as the Father of the Good Mind within us

s: Good Mind gives vigorous might (to Ahura Mazda's friend in spirit and deeds)
q: And He will likewise give the Good Mind's vigorous might to him who in spirit and deeds is His friend

q: those who by means of the doctrinal vows of the harmful Lie are delivering the settlements of Righteousness to death

s: Lie is smitten by the Kingdom (through its force)
q: I will pray for that mighty Kingdom by whose force we may smite the Lie-demon.

s: Ahura Mazda knows and appoints the ruler over both bands (as ruler over both struggling bands)
q: I will come to you all (in my person) with that power, and in that way according to which Ahura Mazda knows and appoints His ruler, that ruler over both the two (struggling) bands

s: the living believers are made by Zarathustra (through preaching mighty truths)
q: With the tongue of Thy mouth do Thou speak it (that as I preach its mighty truths) I may make all the living believers!

s: the two struggling bands receives what Thou hast given (by Thy Spirit, and Thy Fire, and by Thy Righteousness (itself))
q: which Thou hast given by (Thy) Spirit, and (Thy) Fire, and by Thy Righteousness (itself) to the two battling (sides)

s: the two struggling bands lives according to Righteousness (in obedience to him)
q: in order that we (in obedience to him), may live according to Righteousness.

s: the Kingdom is mighty (sought for victory)
q: I will pray for that mighty Kingdom by whose force we may smite the Lie-demon.
